mapper.select: select id, snapshot_time, window_ms, uri, method, request_count, error_4xx, error_5xx, avg_cost_ms, max_cost_ms, qps, in_flight_max, jvm_used_mb, jvm_max_mb, db_active, db_max from qt_access_metric where uri = '*' and snapshot_time >= #{beginTime} and snapshot_time <= #{endTime} order by snapshot_time desc

select uri, method, sum(request_count) as request_count, sum(error_4xx) as error_4xx, sum(error_5xx) as error_5xx, case when sum(request_count) = 0 then 0 else round(sum(avg_cost_ms * request_count) / sum(request_count)) end as avg_cost_ms, max(max_cost_ms) as max_cost_ms, round(sum(request_count) * 1000 / nullif(sum(window_ms), 0), 2) as qps from qt_access_metric where uri <> '*' and snapshot_time >= #{beginTime} and snapshot_time <= #{endTime} group by uri, method order by request_count desc limit 50
